title: NOISE OUT, BIAS IN: TARGETED BIAS INJECTION IN DIFFUSION LANGUAGE MODELS VIA CLOSED-LOOP ACTIVATION STEERING

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the shift in the target-comparator gap (probability of selecting a targeted racial group vs. a comparator group) on ambiguous, multiple-choice questions from the BBQ dataset and SocialStigmaQA benchmark.
Evaluating the shift in selection preference toward a targeted age group ('Old') using ambiguous multiple-choice questions from the BBQ benchmark.
